name: opening_drive_post_gap_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, overnight gaps >0.3% are driven by FII flows, US market close, and macro news absorbed after the Indian close. The first 5 minutes (09:15-09:20) serve as the price discovery window where pre-open auction imbalances resolve into live orders. When this discovery window closes in the same direction as the gap — confirmed by a strong candle body (>55% body/range ratio) and above-average volume — institutional VWAP/TWAP algorithms have committed to directional orders that are only 20-30% filled at 09:20. The residual unfilled institutional demand continues pushing NIFTY 10-20 spot points in the same direction for the next 30-120 seconds, creating a high-probability window for ATM CE/PE entry at exactly 09:20 IST.
core_signal_oneliner: Overnight gap >0.3% with first 5-minute drive aligned to gap direction, strong body ratio, and volume surge confirming unfilled institutional orders pushing continuation at 09:20
